title: VPC networks and subnets
summary: Google Cloud VPC networks are global resources. Their subnets are regional. This is a useful distinction from some other cloud network models.
introduction: Google Cloud VPC networks are global resources. Their subnets are regional. This is a useful distinction from some other cloud network models. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: VPC networks and subnets

blocks.text: The network can contain regional subnets. A subnet's addresses and region matter when attaching resources.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Draw a second subnet in a different region.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not assume a VPC network itself belongs to just one region.
For more detail later, use this [Google Cloud Platform further reading](https://cloud.google.com/docs/overview).
